name: Ride the long trend
tagline: Take the wins, dodge the losses
idea: The strategy signals a buy of a broad index fund when the market moves into an uptrend, and a sale when the trend turns down.
rationale: Markets move in long waves. The strategy signals a buy of a broad index fund when the market moves into an uptrend, and a sale when the trend turns down, to dodge the dip. After the dip it looks for a new buy signal.

rules.text: The market closes more than `3%` above its `SMA 200` (average price over the last 200 days).
The market closes more than `3%` below its SMA 200.
All in, all out: each signal covers the whole budget at once.

backtest.testedDefaults: The whole €3,000 budget, all in, all out.
